name: Arms of Hadar
description: Summons dark energy tendrils from the caster, forcing nearby targets to make a Strength saving throw or take necrotic damage.

name: Armor of Agathys
components: V, S, M (a shard of blue glass)
description: Surrounds the caster in protective magical frost that grants temporary hit points and retaliates with cold damage against melee attackers.

name: Astral Projection
description: Projects the soul and form of the caster and willing allies into the Astral Plane, leaving their physical bodies behind in suspended animation.

name: Aura of Purity
description: Emits a cleansing energy field around the caster that grants nearby allies resistance to poison and protection against multiple adverse conditions.
